slides.say: Testing Library has lots of queries. The docs rank them, and the winner is clear.
Get by role should be your first choice for almost everything. It finds elements the way assistive technology does: a button with the name save.

slides.text: Order: Role → LabelText → PlaceholderText → Text → DisplayValue → AltText → Title → TestId
slides.say: After role comes label text, then placeholder text, text, and display value. Then alt text and title. Test I D is the last resort.
For form fields, use the label. A placeholder is not a substitute for a label.

slides.text: Bonus: if getByRole can't find it, real users may not either.
slides.say: And here's a bonus. If get by role can't find your element, screen reader users may struggle too. The test just found an accessibility bug.
